definition: Sexual intercourse without consent as defined under Section 375 IPC, punishable under Section 376 IPC.
comparability_notes: Definition broadened by the Criminal Law (Amendment) Act 2013 following the 2012 Delhi case; pre-2013 and post-2013 figures are not strictly comparable. From July 2024 IPC was replaced by the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS); rape is now Sections 63-64 BNS. Post-2024 figures need a BNS-to-IPC crosswalk before merging with the IPC-era series.

definition: Individual persons recorded as victims within registered rape cases; one case can have more than one victim.
comparability_notes: Do not treat as interchangeable with 'cases registered' - a single case may list multiple victims, so victim counts are typically >= case counts.

definition: Cases registered where an attempt to rape occurred but the offence was not completed.
comparability_notes: Tracked as a distinct IPC head from completed rape; do not merge into the rape total.

variable: Assault on women with intent to outrage modesty (IPC 354)
definition: Criminal force or assault on a woman intending to, or knowing it is likely to, outrage her modesty.
comparability_notes: Legally and statistically distinct from rape (IPC 376) - a much broader, lower-severity category.

definition: Rape committed by a police officer, public servant, member of the armed forces, or staff of a jail/remand home/hospital while the victim is in their custody or care.
comparability_notes: Subset of total rape cases; carries enhanced punishment provisions.

definition: NCRB's aggregate head covering all IPC/SLL offences classified as crimes against women (cruelty by husband/relatives, kidnapping/abduction of women, assault on modesty, rape, dowry deaths, etc.).
comparability_notes: Rape is typically 6-11% of this aggregate in the years reviewed - do NOT present the all-CAW total as if it were the rape total, and vice versa.

definition: Registered cases of a given category divided by the female population (in lakhs, i.e. hundred-thousands) of the relevant year.
comparability_notes: Denominator is the FEMALE population specifically for crime-against-women rates, not the total population - do not confuse with a total-population-denominated rate.

definition: Proportion of registered cases in which police completed investigation and filed a charge-sheet in court, among cases due for investigation-completion in the reference period.
comparability_notes: Denominator conventions vary by NCRB report year; record the exact denominator used whenever this variable is populated.

definition: Cases convicted as a percentage of cases where trial was completed in the reference year (NOT as a percentage of all cases registered that year).
comparability_notes: Frequently misreported in media as 'X% of rapes end in conviction' - the correct denominator is trials COMPLETED that year, which includes a backlog of cases from prior years' registrations. Do not compute directly from cases_registered without the trial-completed denominator.
